bootstrap_scope: Unused native runtime fixtures only: 96 accepted baseline service artifacts and 3 adversarial fixtures; zero orders, deliveries, customers, collections or revenue from them. These are not the confidential-capability experiment's output.

financial_summary_microUSD.assuranceScope: Local provider assumption only; full late-debit reserve retained for conservative investment
financial_summary_microUSD.fundingScope: Bounded principal-plus-fee exposure; arbitrary additional debits are not guaranteed

native_audit.journal_authenticity_scope: Public source/native commitments verified; private local WAL HMAC checked only on owner reopen.
native_audit.signature_scope: Public audit verifies native finance and state/action commitments. Private local HMAC authenticity is checked only by the account owner.

summary.assuranceScope: Local provider assumption only; full late-debit reserve retained for conservative investment
summary.fundingScope: Bounded principal-plus-fee exposure; arbitrary additional debits are not guaranteed

trailing_profit.accounting_basis: Recognized revenue plus recovery income minus incurred expenses; signed revisions retained. Seed and principal reserve releases are not profit. Payables remain incurred expenses even when unpaid. Taxes enter only when recorded as native expense; no added hypothetical tax/depreciation.

interval.boundary: [start,end); all same-hour actions included or excluded together

limits: Requires independent native and operating audits of the source result.
Existing modeled cost coverage and unknown host/model billing are unchanged.
No annualization, pooled enterprises, forward inference, or spending authority.
Post-operating settlement drain remains on the account but is excluded from this operating-window measure.

native_endpoint_summary.assuranceScope: Local provider assumption only; full late-debit reserve retained for conservative investment
native_endpoint_summary.fundingScope: Bounded principal-plus-fee exposure; arbitrary additional debits are not guaranteed

trailing_profit.obligation_scope: Endpoint native summary preserved, not a new reserve-coverage or complete-cost qualification.

year_scope: Closed modeled discovery and asset-maintenance interval [0,8760), with no commercial operation or annualized sales. Full authored envelopes are expensed, including failed-attempt and idle maintenance allowances; these are not observed bills.
